applicability.required_for: every Motion Control Lab app that publishes IK visualization
applicability.non_ik_apps: not applicable; an app must not fabricate unavailable IK or FK data

channels.semantics: Names and positions describe the output state for this sample; velocities are optional but must use the same name order.
The left Cartesian pose received by the app before any app-specific target projection.
The right Cartesian pose received by the app before any app-specific target projection.
Actual left end-effector FK computed from the joint positions published in /mc/ik/joint_states for the same sample.
Actual right end-effector FK computed from the joint positions published in /mc/ik/joint_states for the same sample.

coherence.sample: All five messages in one visualization update describe one logical sample.
coherence.timestamp: All five messages use the visualization frame emit timestamp.
coherence.pose_reference_frame: Each PoseInFrame carries the model reference frame used by the producing app.
coherence.fk_invariant: FK output must be recomputable from the joint positions in the same sample and must never be copied from a target pose.
